The file lists the sphere centres (nm) of a model polystyrene opal crystallite built from a published sphere diameter; neighbouring spheres touch. Model conditions: the only measured input is the sphere diameter reported by Gazmeh et al. (Sci. Rep. 2025, Table 3; field-emission SEM); the spheres are identical (no size dispersion), touch their neighbours and sit on an ideal close-packed lattice without stacking faults, vacancies or cracks, which is the idealization behind the paper's Bragg-law estimate of the reflection peak. Each crystallite is a finite cut of 177 spheres in an arbitrary orientation. What is the sphere diameter, in nm?

选项：
A. 104.4 nm
B. 147.7 nm
C. 170.5 nm
D. 208.8 nm

附件：opal-PS-S8.xyz（均为本题完整输入）。范围：按论文 FESEM 球径构建的理想接触球 FCC 晶粒模型（177 个球心，确定性旋转）；不含尺寸分布与堆垛缺陷，不是实测球心坐标。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
